acceptanceCriteria: Ceiling expiry and SIGINT cancellation return distinct, owned error codes, not MALFORMED.
body: Found by lane V1-1547 (claim --detach, PR beamfall/corvint#1015, head 01eae41a5, base 8fa297eae, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Ceiling expiry or SIGINT cancellation during claim --detach surfaces as MALFORMED with 'context deadline exceeded'. Expected: a distinct stable code (e.g. timeout/cancelled) so callers can retry correctly.
title: claim --detach ceiling expiry or SIGINT maps to MALFORMED context deadline exceeded
